research_gaps: Absence of a comprehensive, up‑to‑date survey that systematically reviews monocular depth estimation advances (2023‑2025).
No standardized benchmark suite that jointly evaluates accuracy, real‑time performance, domain adaptation, and robustness to adverse conditions.
Limited exploration of multimodal fusion (e.g., RGB+event, RGB+LiDAR) and uncertainty estimation within a unified depth prediction framework.

proposals.name: Automated Living Survey Platform
proposals.rationale: Use NLP crawling, citation graph analysis, and summarisation models to continuously ingest new papers, extract architecture/training details, and produce a structured, searchable survey.
proposals.expected_benefit: Keeps the community informed with minimal manual effort; provides a single source of truth for trends, datasets, and performance tables.
proposals.risk: Potential extraction errors for complex methodological nuances; requires maintenance of crawling pipelines and handling paywalled content.

proposals.name: Unified Benchmark Suite for Monocular Depth
proposals.rationale: Define a common evaluation protocol across KITTI, NYU‑Depth V2, SYNTHIA‑Depth, and emerging synthetic corpora, including metrics for latency, domain shift, and robustness (e.g., rain, fog, night).
proposals.expected_benefit: Enables fair comparison of self‑supervised vs. supervised methods, drives progress on edge‑friendly models, and highlights gaps in real‑world deployment.
proposals.risk: Benchmark could become overly prescriptive; community adoption may be slow without incentives from major conferences or journals.

proposals.name: Multimodal Self‑Supervised Depth Framework with Uncertainty
proposals.rationale: Design a modular architecture that fuses RGB images with complementary sensors (events, sparse LiDAR) using self‑supervised photometric and cross‑modal consistency losses, while learning per‑pixel confidence via Bayesian or Monte‑Carlo dropout heads.
proposals.expected_benefit: Improves depth accuracy under challenging lighting, provides calibrated uncertainty for downstream planning, and offers a baseline for multimodal research.
proposals.risk: Increased system complexity may hinder reproducibility; training stability can be sensitive to loss weighting and sensor synchronization.

recommended_option: Unified Benchmark Suite for Monocular Depth
